note: Aliases: tableofcontents. Inserts a TOC field (complex fldChar). The cached result stays empty until `officecli refresh <file> --toc`, which rebuilds entries from Heading styles and outline levels (titles and in-document hyperlinks) without Microsoft Word. PAGEREF page numbers are the placeholder 0 on that path. Real page numbers need Word (or `officecli refresh` without --toc when a headless browser can paginate the HTML preview). `\z` in the field means pageNumbers=false for this writer, not Word's web-layout switch.

pageNumbers.description: include page numbers in TOC entries (Add/Set use lowercase alias 'pagenumbers').
pageNumbers.readback: true if TOC includes page numbers
